comment: Written against Codex CLI 2026 (Rust/ratatui TUI). Codex was not available in the sandbox: screens were transcribed from documented UI text and must be re-verified against live sessions. The command/patch approval dialog ('Allow command?', 'Yes (y)', '[y/n]'), the trust-directory prompt and the 'press enter to confirm or esc to cancel' forms are BLOCKED; the '• Working (…s • esc to interrupt)' status line is WORKING; the '›' composer with its '⏎ send' footer is IDLE. The composer stays visible while Codex works, so the idle rule vetoes on 'esc to interrupt' and has the lowest priority; the approval rule vetoes on it too and anchors its patterns, because command output echoed in the transcript ('Continue? [y/n] n') must not read as an approval dialog. No rule depends on the alternate-screen flag.

anyLineRegex: (?i)press enter to confirm or esc to cancel
(?i)Do you trust the contents of this directory
